test_objective: Check that you can query entitites via POST Interaction asking for a GeoJSON representation

test_cases.name: 019_02_05 Query several entities via POST Interaction asking for a GeoJSON representation
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query entities via POST Interaction asking for a GeoJSON representation
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/query'
        method set to 'POST'
        Get Entities Via POST Request: and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${entity_types_to_be_retrieved}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/geo+json' and
    Query Parameter: geoproperty set to 'location' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json'
}
